name: telegram-mcp
description: Read, search and send Telegram messages from your own account via Telethon

session_name.title: Private native session path
session_name.description: New setup: use the absolute private path printed by session setup, outside the bundle and allowed files directory. Choose this OR an existing legacy session string; leave the other empty. Stop any process using this authorization before connecting.

session_string.title: Existing legacy session string
session_string.description: Existing installations only: choose this OR a private native session path, leaving the other empty. Anyone holding this string has account access. New session setup creates private native files and does not export strings.

allowed_chat_ids.title: Allowed chats
allowed_chat_ids.description: Optional comma-separated chat IDs or @usernames. When set, every other chat is hidden from Claude.

allowed_root.title: Files directory
allowed_root.description: Optional directory that file tools (send_file, download_media, ...) may read from and write to.
